# Astronomical v0.2.44
## Changes
- Model serving now loads expert-pruned OptiQ (REAP) artifacts whose `optiq_metadata.json` records only pruning provenance and carries no measured bit-map. Previously those artifacts failed to load at metadata decode. The OptiQ metadata validator accepts any provenance-only shape through one discriminator — the presence of a measured bit-map — rather than a pruning-method name, so the current and future expert-compression methods are supported without new code. - The `Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-OptiQ-4bit-REAP-19B` variant is published to the model library and offered for one-click download through Observatory and the menu.
## Compatibility
- Backward compatible: the change is additive. Models that were rejected before this release continue to be rejected; the release does not change how models rejected ahead of it behave. - Requires Apple Silicon macOS with the `mlx-optiq` optional dependency at runtime.
## Preserved state
- Existing models, configuration, and local release state are preserved through the update.
## Distribution
- Distributed as a signed, Apple-notarized DMG. Assets are published bound by SHA-256 digests in the release manifest, and the signed Sparkle feed is activated through a separate signed update. The release is not installed or launched as part of publishing; it is delivered through the ordinary public download or Sparkle update journey, exactly as every user receives it.
